rule: Each paper has exactly one author labelled first, and it is the author at order 1
Every LU paper lists at least one author affiliated with LU
evidence_in_data: 6 of 5,211 do not; all 6 list exactly 100 authors, the OpenAlex cap, so the LU author was cut off (rules_checks.py, rule B)

rule: A DOI identifies exactly one paper
evidence_in_data: 5,057 DOIs, 5,055 distinct: 2 DOIs each shared by two OpenAlex records of the same paper (profile_tables.py, look_closer.py)

rule: Every authorship has an OpenAlex author ID
An ORCID identifies exactly one author record
evidence_in_data: 9,081 records with an ORCID, 9,061 distinct, so 20 extra records share one (profile_tables.py)

rule: OpenAlex lists at most 100 authors per paper
evidence_in_data: 19 papers at exactly 100; 6 of them lose their LU author (look_closer.py, rules_checks.py)

rule: Every paper has a journal or venue
